alt: A light blue vinyl-wrapped Slate electric pickup truck with its hood open on display near the Space Needle in Seattle, surrounded by curious onlookers
story: Slate Auto's bare-bones electric pickup is starting Q4 2026 deliveries with no factory paint (just raw plastic panels), no infotainment, no speakers, and hand-crank windows — software updates require you to plug your phone into a USB port.
why_funny: In 2026, the cutting-edge EV asks you to hand-crank your windows and plug your phone in like it's 2004.
